action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that rkhunter downloaded mirror updates over an insecure
channel. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute
arbitrary code.
isummary:
rkhunter could be made to run programs if it received specially crafted
network traffic.

rkhunter.description: rootkit, backdoor, sniffer and exploit scanner

title: rkhunter vulnerability
